Source audit recovered the original container-centered README; the problem is declared-vs-actual entrypoint/ownership and unverified action enforcement, not proof that the container has no intended role. Healthy means SSH cold readiness. Codex --no-daemon helper versus shared-daemon context is an explicit verification decision, not a blanket flag change.
